scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(f,{force:true}); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:external && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/goat-mobile run test:frontend-contract
scripts.test:all: corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration && corepack pnpm run test:e2e && corepack pnpm run test:place-coverage && corepack pnpm run test:condition-sensitivity
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run test:all
